name: app-goldrates-api-kit
description: Daily India gold and silver rates (IBJA, via Metals.dev) for Expo + Firebase apps: a 5 AM IST weekday Cloud Function that saves one row a day in Firestore and publishes the rate to Remote Config, plus the app side that reads it with its date and a stale warning. No app words or colors.
author: Yuvaraj Salla

scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-goldrates "vitest run --config emulator-tests/vitest.config.mts"
